content: Aditi Mahajan calls insurance agent Neha Kapoor because her current health policy is expiring on 30/09/2026 and cannot be renewed due to being phased out. Concerned about a coverage gap, Aditi agrees to switch to the 'Balanced Care' plan at ₹4,850 per month. Neha confirms she will send the enrollment form and a confirmation email, with the new policy becoming effective on 01/10/2026.

action_items: Neha to send the enrollment form for the Balanced Care plan to Aditi
Neha to send a confirmation email with the effective date of 01/10/2026
Aditi to fill out the enrollment form
